## Quantified Delivery Highlights
- **PKR 103M+ Cost Savings (22.5% Under Budget):** Delivered portfolio cost controls and Earned Value Management (EVM) forecasting on Pakistan's nationwide FBR Track & Trace program.
- **PKR 700M+ Multi-Site Portfolio (150+ Sites):** Directed project planning, PMO governance, and executive Power BI reporting at AJCL.
- **60% Lower Operating Costs (6M Liters Fuel Saved):** Product engineering and IoT telemetry delivery for Telenor Pakistan's Thunder platform across national telecom tower infrastructure.
- **600,000+ Daily Users & 60% Lower Cloud Infrastructure Cost:** Coordinated AWS serverless commerce re-platforming for PrettyLittleThing and unified multi-brand returns operations for Boohoo Group.
- **100% Paperless Regulatory Workflow:** Delivered the digital spectrum application portal and review workflow for Pakistan's Frequency Allocation Board (FAB).

## Proprietary SaaS Products Built by Haris Arshad
1. **Hubito — Precision Workspace & Task Command Center**
   - **Live URL:** https://hubito.harisarshad.site/tour
   - **Summary:** Executive workspace and task command center combining tactile Kanban swimlanes, List/Board/Calendar views, Pomodoro cadence time-blocking, and local-first Cloudflare edge sync.
   - **Stack:** Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Cloudflare, Lucide Icons.
2. **Pacio — Next-Gen Agile Engine & Modern Sprint Tracker**
   - **Live URL:** https://pacio.harisarshad.site/
   - **Workspace URL:** https://pacio.harisarshad.site/dashboard
   - **Summary:** High-velocity alternative to Jira and Linear featuring sub-50ms Kanban boards, sprint backlogs, velocity sparklines, integrated Markdown ADR/PRD tech specs, Git PR tracking, and multi-tenant corporate RBAC on Cloudflare Workers & D1 SQLite.
   - **Stack:** Next.js, TypeScript, Cloudflare Workers, Cloudflare D1 (SQLite), Tailwind CSS, Git Integration.
